meaning:
1) to hedge or fence up or about
1a) (Qal) to fence about, hedge up

renderings.kjv: Hast not thou made an hedge

elsewhere.note: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance…
Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
